cards.text: State unemployment rates in July 2026 ranged from 2% in SD to 5.9% in DC.
Q1 2026 house price growth over the year ranged from -2.4% in CO to 7.3% in IL.
Q1 2026 state GDP growth over the year ranged from -1.3% in DC to 3.7% in KS.
Among states, July 2026 average weekly earnings ranged from MS’s $1,029 to WA’s $1,504.
In July 2026, manufacturing employment fell year-over-year in 27 states and DC.
Only two states saw year-over-year growth in gov. GDP in Q1 2026: MI (+0.1%) and TX (+1.3%).
In Q1 2026, house prices in RI declined year-on-year for the first time in 13 years.
Just two states posted year-over-year growth in retail GDP in Q1 2026: AR and TX (both 0.1%).
Leisure and hospitality jobs in July 2026 were below July 2019 levels in IN and 17 other states.
